fact: The party visits Gartokkar's residence to conclude their contract.
source_quote: The party visits Gartokkar at his residence to deliver a corrupted dragon egg, collect their final payment
subject: Gartokkar's residence

fact: Gartokkar expresses surprise that the party survived, having heard rumors of powerful wizards and assassins in the area.
source_quote: Gartokkar expresses surprise at the party's survival, having heard rumors of powerful wizards and assassins in the area
subject: Gartokkar

fact: Gartokkar remembered Daz as a mere third-level drow wizard and dismissed him as clearly not the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: He remembered Daz as a mere third-level drow wizard, "so clearly it wasn't you."
subject: Daz

fact: The party jokes about new names to escape the Ember Vanguard's reputation, including "The Gold Vanguard," "The Gold Ember Vanguard," and "The Disciples of Bahamut."
source_quote: The party jokes about a new name to escape the Ember Vanguard's reputation: "The Gold Vanguard," "The Gold Ember Vanguard," "The Disciples of Bahamut."
subject: naming discussion

fact: Daz plays cagey about the mission details.
source_quote: Daz plays cagey ("We saw many eggs")
subject: Daz's deception

fact: Gartokkar demands the egg from Daz.
source_quote: Gartokkar calls him a fool, dismisses him as clearly not the Ember Vanguard, and demands the egg.
subject: egg demand

fact: The DM recaps that the deal consists of 2,000 gp offered, 600 gp up front, and a 1,000 gp confidentiality rider for a total of 3,000 gp.
source_quote: The DM recaps the deal: 2,000 gp offered, 600 gp (30%) up front, plus a 1,000 gp confidentiality rider, for a total of 3,000 gp
subject: confidentiality recap

fact: The party hands over the red dragon egg, noting it is covered in ritualistic markings and its viability is uncertain.
source_quote: The party hands over the red dragon egg, noting that it is covered in ritualistic markings and its viability is uncertain.
subject: red dragon egg

fact: The party declines to clean the ritual drawings off the egg, choosing to present it as-is.
source_quote: They decline to clean the ritual drawings off, choosing to present the egg as-is.
subject: egg presentation

fact: Gyrgum states he is no expert on the egg and only knows about metallic dragons.
source_quote: He adds that he "only really know[s] about the metallic dragons."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gartokkar explains the strategic necessity of the egg is to replace the dragon Themberchaud before the beast realizes he is not truly in control of the city.
source_quote: Gartokkar explains the strategic necessity of the egg to replace the dragon Themberchaud before the beast realizes he is not truly in control of the city.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: The DM reminds the party that they are separately Themberchaud's agents.
source_quote: The DM reminds the party that they are separately Themberchaud's agents, which is fine "as long as he doesn't notice you."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gartokkar pays the party their remaining gold, including the pre-negotiated confidentiality fee.
source_quote: Gartokkar pays the party their remaining gold, including a pre-negotiated confidentiality fee.
subject: payment

fact: Gartokkar fetches a bag containing 2,400 gp.
source_quote: He fetches a bag containing 2,400 gp.
subject: payment bag

fact: Gartokkar claims that whatever deal was made stayed between them and that he may have already forgotten.
source_quote: Gartokkar: "Whatever deal I made with you stayed between you and me. I may have already forgotten."
subject: Gartokkar

fact: The party's spreadsheet shows 1,042 gp plus one electrum each.
source_quote: The party's spreadsheet shows 1,042 gp plus one electrum each.
subject: party spreadsheet

fact: A 1,000 gp pearl item is still unsold by the party.
source_quote: A 1,000 gp pearl item is still unsold.
subject: 1,000 gp pearl item

fact: Gartokkar repeats the rumor that the Deepking's agents are everywhere.
source_quote: Gartokkar repeats the rumor that the Deepking's agents are everywhere
subject: Deepking's agents

fact: Gartokkar describes the Deepking's agents as a mercenary band of four so fierce the Stone Guard fear them.
source_quote: a mercenary band of four so fierce the Stone Guard fear them
subject: Deepking's agents

fact: Gartokkar warns that the Stone Guard are doubling their patrols.
source_quote: warns that the Stone Guard are doubling their patrols.
subject: Stone Guard

source_quote: Gartokkar: "The derro are on edge after the assassination of their leaders."
subject: Derro

source_quote: The party learns about the history of the derro, their madness stemming from mind flayer experiments
subject: Derro

source_quote: and their dangerous plots involving Demogorgon.
subject: Derro

fact: The Blink pushed the derro over the edge.
source_quote: The Blink pushed the derro over the edge.
subject: Blink

source_quote: The High Council had been co-opted by the Deepking to keep the derro under control.
subject: High Council
